cover.title: Why Every Screen Wants a Tip

lines.say: A six-dollar coffee. A fifty percent tip button.

lines.text: Square's optional Smart tip screen offers $1, $2 or $3 on sales under $10. On $6, that's about 17%, 33% or 50%.
lines.say: Square's optional Smart tip screen offers one, two or three dollars on sales under ten dollars. On six dollars, that's about seventeen, thirty-three or fifty percent.

lines.text: In 2023, 72% told Pew tipping is expected in more places than five years earlier.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-three, seventy-two percent told Pew tipping is expected in more places than five years earlier.

lines.text: Why? Checkout tablets come with preset tip buttons, so any counter can ask.
lines.say: Why? Checkout tablets come with preset tip buttons, so any counter can ask.

lines.text: Yet Toast's average quick-service tip slipped from 17.0% in early 2022 to 15.8% in early 2026.
lines.say: Yet Toast's average quick-service tip slipped from seventeen percent in early twenty twenty-two to fifteen point eight percent in early twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: In Bankrate's 2025 survey, 27% tip less or nothing facing pre-entered tip screens. 11% tip more.
lines.say: In Bankrate's twenty twenty-five survey, twenty-seven percent tip less or nothing facing pre-entered tip screens. Eleven percent tip more.

lines.text: Federal law allows a tipped cash wage of $2.13 an hour, if tips bring pay to $7.25.
lines.say: Federal law allows a tipped cash wage of two dollars and thirteen cents an hour, if tips bring pay to seven dollars and twenty-five cents.

lines.text: Tip screens aren't required by law. They're a store setting with presets.

post.title: Tipflation: why a $6 coffee screen can ask for a 50% tip
post.ig:
A $6 coffee. A 50% tip button.

Square's optional Smart tip setting shows $1, $2 or $3 on sales under $10; on $6 that's about 17%, 33% or 50%.
72% of US adults told Pew (2023) tipping is expected in more places than five years earlier.
Yet Toast's average quick-service tip slipped from 17.0% (Q1 2022) to 15.8% (Q1 2026).
Bankrate (2025): 27% tip less or nothing with a preset tip screen; 11% tip more.

Sources: Square; Pew Research Center; Toast; Bankrate; US Dept of Labor.
News and education, not financial advice.
